The '''Zephyr-G swoop''' was a [[Swoop/Legends|swoop]] produced by [[Mobquet Swoops and Speeders/Legends|Mobquet]] around thirty years before the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]]. [[Owen Lars/Legends|Owen Lars]] owned a Zephyr-G on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] prior to the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. It was designed for sport racing, but could be used as the utility vehicle as well.

==Characteristics==
[[File:ZephyrG-TSS.jpg|thumb|left|180px|A Zephyr-G and pilot]]

The Mobquet Zephyr-G was a utilitarian [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] swoop, able to seat a single rider, though a passenger could perch somewhat uncomfortably on the drive section. The power generator was located at the rear of the bike, flanked by two cargo panniers capable of holding up to 100 kilograms of supplies. Its inhibitors prevented it from raising more than 6 meters above the ground. Like most swoops it emphasized speed and power over safety and maneuverability.

==History==
Owen Lars purchased [[Owen Lars' swoop bike/Legends|his swoop bike]] from a [[Revwien/Legends|Revwien]] trader in [[Mos Nytram/Legends|Mos Nytram]]. Already twenty years old at the time of purchase, Owen converted the battered Zephyr-G from a sports bike to work as a farm vehicle.

[[File:Anakin_looking_dramatic.png|thumb|right|300px|Anakin Skywalker races across the sands of Tatooine in search of his mother on Owen Lars's swoop]]
During his desperate search for his [[Shmi Skywalker Lars/Legends|mother]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] borrowed Owen's swoop bike, racing into the [[Jundland Wastes/Legends|Jundland Wastes]] to track her down. Though Anakin located the [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raider]] camp in which Shmi was being held, the young [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] arrived in time only to witness her death. He carried her body back to the [[Lars homestead/Legends|Lars moisture farm]] on the swoop after slaughtering a [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raider]] tribe.

During the [[Battle of Jabiim]], Anakin used a Zephyr-G swoop to get to the evacuating by order of the [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]]. After he left the [[Cobalt Station]], Anakin lost the swoop bike to several [[A-series assassin droid]]s, forcing him to walk back.
